title: Will SpaceX and Tesla Merge? I'm Predicting a Megamerger for 1 Surprising Reason
title_zh: SpaceX 和特斯拉会合并吗？我预测大型合并有一个令人惊讶的原因
summary: Experts are starting to believe in a potential megamerger.
summary_zh: 专家们开始相信大型合并的可能性。

title: Adding a Healthcare Stock to Your Portfolio? FHLC Offers Broad Coverage While PPH Leads in Returns.
title_zh: 将医疗保健股票添加到您的投资组合中？ FHLC 提供广泛的覆盖范围，而 PPH 的回报率领先。
summary: Expense ratios, asset size, and portfolio strategy set these two healthcare ETFs apart, yet their risk and dividend profiles tell a different story.
summary_zh: 费用比率、资产规模和投资组合策略使这两只医疗保健 ETF 与众不同，但它们的风险和股息状况却截然不同。

title: Alphabet Pivots From Buybacks to a Massive Stock Offering. What It Means for Shares.
title_zh: Alphabet 从回购转向大规模股票发行。这对股票意味着什么。
summary: Alphabet  said it would issue $80 billion of equity, including $10 billion of stock to  Berkshire Hathaway  as it funds its huge AI computing infrastructure buildout.
summary_zh: Alphabet 表示，将发行 800 亿美元的股票，其中包括向伯克希尔哈撒韦公司发行 100 亿美元的股票，为其庞大的人工智能计算基础设施建设提供资金。

title: Bloom Energy’s AI Power Deals Test Valuation And Execution Expectations
title_zh: Bloom Energy 的 AI Power 交易测试估值和执行预期
summary: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) has signed multi gigawatt fuel cell agreements with Oracle to supply on site power for AI data centers. The company announced a $5b partnership with Brookfield Asset Management focused on large scale clean power deployments.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）已与 Oracle 签署了多吉瓦燃料电池协议，为人工智能数据中心提供现场电力。该公司宣布与 Brookfield Asset Management 建立 50 亿美元的合作伙伴关系，重点关注大规模清洁能源部署。

title: Top ETF Stories of May 2026: Iran Deal Hopes, AI Rally
title_zh: 2026 年 5 月 ETF 热门故事：伊朗协议希望、人工智能反弹
summary: Iran deal hopes, AI-fueled tech gains and Dell's upbeat outlook lifted stocks to record highs, while inflation fears and space-stock volatility persisted.
summary_zh: 伊朗协议的希望、人工智能推动的科技股上涨以及戴尔的乐观前景将股市推升至历史新高，而通胀担忧和太空股波动持续存在。
